import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    F = params[0] + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]/t + params[4]*t**params[5]
    G = params[6] + params[7]*np.log(t) + params[8]*np.exp(-params[9]*t)
    return F + G*A**2
